measurements.frame: NBI item 58; 0-9 numeric or N for not applicable
minimum numeric value among items 58, 59, 60 and 62 in the snapshot
cohort year minus item 27 year built when year built is usable
June 15 snapshot month minus item 90 MMYY inspection month

external_threshold.source: FHWA Good/Fair/Poor classification: lowest rating <=4 is Poor

cross_row_audit.auxiliary_files_review: Only the three declared CSV outputs; no fixture labels, answer scaffolds or auxiliary evaluation files are written.
cross_row_audit.rationale: Each row is one independent bridge-cohort observation; no cross-row joins are required at evaluation.

bridge_id.availability: Constructed from state code, structure number and cohort year; stable within this release.

snapshot_datetime.availability: Cohort date set to June 15 from FHWA finalization statement; exact publication day is not verified.

state_code.availability: Item 1 in the same annual record; carrying agency identity, not a performance measurement.

deck_rating.availability: Item 58 in the same annual snapshot record; N is retained as not applicable and is not imputed as zero.

superstructure_rating.availability: Item 59 in the same annual snapshot record; N is retained as not applicable.

substructure_rating.availability: Item 60 in the same annual snapshot record; N is retained as not applicable.

culvert_rating.availability: Item 62 in the same annual snapshot record; N is retained as not applicable.

channel_rating.availability: Item 61 in the same annual snapshot record; N is retained as not applicable.

lowest_component_rating.availability: Derived only from snapshot items 58, 59, 60 and 62; no future inspection values enter the feature.

year_built.availability: Item 27 in the same annual record; blank when the source value is unusable, never filled with a guess.

bridge_age_years.availability: Derived from cohort year and item 27; blank when year built is unusable.

months_since_inspection.availability: Derived from the June 15 snapshot and item 90 month-year; month precision only.

numeric_component_count.availability: Count of numeric applicable component ratings in the snapshot; not a condition score.

culvert_applicable.availability: Flag for a numeric item 62 culvert rating in the snapshot.

limitations: Current-vintage reconstruction: annual NBI archives may be corrected or updated after first publication, so these are not necessarily the exact bytes available at a historical decision instant.
No full-row historical availability ledger exists; feature availability and the absence of later revisions are assumed, not verified.

The supplied evidence gives exact fixed offsets only for items 1, 8, 5A, 27, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62, 90 and CAT23. Material/design, size, traffic, network-role, load-capacity, geometry, deck-system and scour groups were not shipped because guessing their offsets would fabricate values. This limits the broad feature question but does not alter the population, label or splits.
The population requires a later recorded inspection with numeric component ratings; bridges without one are right-censored and absent.
Item 90 is four characters; the supplied prose calls it YYYYMM, which cannot fit four positions. It is parsed as the NBI month-year MMYY, with six-digit input accepted defensively.
Inspection date comparisons use month precision, so a June inspection after June 15 is conservatively treated as not strictly after the snapshot.
State-submitted NBI records can carry state-law interests even though the federal dataset is public domain; attribution and upstream rights are preserved.
Condition ratings are inspector judgments with state-level variation; no inter-rater correction is applied.

selection.evidence: Eligibility uses only annual snapshot fields: record type 1, item 90 within 24 months before June 15, at least one numeric component rating and no numeric component rating at or below 4. The label uses a later inspection record, so the population is conditioned on observing a later inspection.

vintage.evidence: FHWA annual archives downloaded now; FHWA states NBI data may be corrected or updated throughout the year.

prediction_instant.citation: FHWA states NBI data is considered final on June 15 and published shortly thereafter; the exact publication day is not verified.

row_selection.rule: Keep highway bridge records with record type 1 whose item 90 MMYY inspection date is no later than the June 15 snapshot and no more than 24 months earlier, with at least one numeric 58/59/60/62 rating and no numeric rating at or below 4; require a later record after the snapshot for the outcome.

task.decision_user: A state or local bridge program manager deciding which Fair bridges to program for preservation, repair or replacement before the next inspection cycle.
task.question: At the annual NBI snapshot, which currently Good-or-Fair highway bridges will be classified Poor at their next recorded inspection?
task.population: Bridge records with item 5A record type 1 in the annual file for cohort year Y, whose item 90 MMYY inspection date falls within 24 months before the June 15 snapshot, whose numeric applicable component ratings (58, 59, 60, 62) all remain at or above 5, and for which a further record with an inspection date strictly after the June 15 snapshot exists in files Y+1 through 2024. Records with no numeric component rating are dropped; records already Poor are excluded and counted. Year built is used for the identity guard only when both snapshots carry it.
task.prediction_time: June 15 of cohort year Y, the date FHWA treats that year's NBI file as final; only fields in that same annual record are used.
task.outcome_horizon: The bridge's next recorded inspection after the June 15 snapshot, observed in annual files Y+1 through 2024. Bridges with no later inspection are right-censored and dropped.
task.usefulness: The label is a future inspection outcome and is not present in the snapshot; current ratings, CAT23 and age are present, so the model cannot copy the answer. This release tests the condition, age, inspection-timing and state-identity portion of the original question. The material, traffic, geometry, load, deck-system and scour groups were not shipped because their exact fixed offsets were not independently verified in the supplied evidence; omitting guessed values is preferable to fabricating them.
task.simple_references: Always-negative base rate share of eligible bridges that stay non-Poor; one-field heuristic using current lowest component rating 5 versus 6; age-decade rate using item 27; state-level majority or mean rate using item 1; logistic model on current ratings plus age only.

features.name: component_ratings
features.meaning: Separate item 58 deck, 59 superstructure, 60 substructure and 62 culvert ratings, plus the minimum numeric component rating. N is retained as not applicable, not converted to zero.
features.availability: Present in the same annual snapshot record at the decision instant.

features.name: rating_applicability
features.meaning: Count of numeric applicable component ratings and a culvert-applicability flag.
features.availability: Derived only from the snapshot ratings.

features.name: age
features.meaning: Item 27 year built and cohort year minus year built.
features.availability: Present in the same annual record when the source value is usable; blank otherwise.

features.name: inspection_cycle
features.meaning: Months between the item 90 inspection month and the June 15 snapshot.
features.availability: Known at the decision instant at month precision.

features.name: ownership
features.meaning: Item 1 state code as the reporting-agency identity control.
features.availability: Present in the same annual record.

construction_notes: Built from FHWA NBI annual archives 2018-2024 through the documented download interstitial and fetch. Fixed-width parsing uses the exact supplied offsets for items 1, 8, 5A, 27, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62, 90 and CAT23. Item 90 is four characters at 287-290; because four positions cannot hold YYYYMM, it is parsed as the NBI MMYY month-year, with six-digit input accepted defensively. Header-bearing CSV members are also supported by alias mapping and fail loudly with selected member, observed headers and missing names. Population and label rules are fixed: record type 1, inspection within 24 months before June 15, at least one numeric component rating and none at or below 4, next record strictly after the snapshot, no numeric next rating dropped rather than labelled negative. Already-Poor records are counted and excluded, not aborted. Each bridge is assigned at its earliest eligible cohort and contributes once; later records resolve the next inspection, and year-built changes drop the pair. Persistent references are null because no persistence score exists; state_code is offered only as a train-only identity reference. Major missing evidence: exact fixed offsets for material/design, size, traffic, network role, load capacity, geometry, deck system and scour were not independently verified in the supplied evidence, so those columns were not shipped. This is an explicit coverage limitation, not a claim that the original broad feature question is fully tested. No holdout values were used to choose the target, features, thresholds or splits.
